event.title: SpaceX's Starship Launches into Orbit but Ends Early
event.canonical_title: SpaceX's Starship Launches into Orbit but Ends Early
event.summary: SpaceX's Starship, a powerful spacecraft, launched into orbit for the first time but concluded its flight prematurely. The spacecraft reentered over the Pacific Ocean and splashed down north of Hawaii approximately three hours after its launch from Texas. The mission aimed for a 10-hour flight with six laps around Earth to demonstrate readiness for NASA's Artemis moon program.
